The retained build log records one successful 530-second Build-Local run at c67881f3fb8892cae09cdf4cc4f370170f20afc8 and successful strict package validation. Only documentation and evidence changed between that producer and the review commit.

The focused records show that the ordinary reader refused the restored-source icon edit and the edited case-variant README. The clean package passed with 457 repository members compared and remained admitted after an unshipped review note. Both archive-replacement directions were refused, and the matching archive passed.

I cross-checked the receipt, retained layout, reader output and audit. They identify ZIP d8d14600c8c0fa0c0abc117cba1c1f0cb8fe446983d1bd23e2ddf5625bb29929, DLL 17a42879a57dba9914cebd67b3855ad95a94ef64775a8c2f66886ef5f03c808a and MVID 5efdffb9-c4ac-4a3e-91f7-089a12991064. The validation summary and selected-test log match their receipt digests. The audit resolved 23 types and 67 members on 0.31.1, 0.32.4, owner 0.33.0 and 0.33.4.
All 48 indexed exported SHA-256 values matched their committed Git blobs. The focused suite source also matched its recorded digest.

required_gaps: Verified cleanup of this run’s disposable fixture followed by admission at the retained producer.
A cleanup target tied to this run that preserves the producer and shared Git metadata.
Accurate attribution of the original failed completion result and the later split summary.
source_inspection_only: The writer and both staging readers pass the expected archive digest to the comparison helper. The helper hashes and reads the ZIP through one handle opened with read sharing, resolves copied members to canonical Git paths, and preserves the separate compiled-DLL checks.
A read-only evaluation of the completion helper’s path predicates accepted both an unrelated prefixed fixture and a parent containing a producer. No filesystem cleanup was performed during review.

findings.actual: The driver and completion attempt encountered access denial on multi-pack-index. The export records fixture_area_removed=false. The real reader returned the correct identities after that attempt, but there is no observation following verified cleanup.
findings.blocking_rationale: OWNER AMENDMENT 4 explicitly orders fixture cleanup before the final admission observation. The retained layout and matching audit establish the other parts of R7-F2.
findings.expected: After cleanup of the disposable fixture, the development reader admits the same frozen package at its receipt-bound location with RequireCurrentMaterialInputs.
findings.requested_correction: Establish what remains in the exact disposable directory and complete the authorized cleanup if permissions allow. Preserve any protected remnant and report the denial if it persists. Reuse the retained candidate for the post-cleanup read.
findings.requested_evidence: Record the verified cleanup outcome, followed by the real reader’s command, exit status, producer, ZIP SHA-256, DLL SHA-256 and MVID at the canonical location. Compare those identities with the existing audit.
findings.title: Verify retained admission after fixture cleanup
findings.trigger: The final handoff uses the reader result obtained after the disposable fixture removal failed.

findings.actual: The completion helper accepts any worktrees path with the focused-r9- prefix. It treats an absent path as successful cleanup and checks containment in the wrong direction to protect a producer below the supplied path. For an existing target it recursively clears read-only attributes, including on Git files the run identifies as hard-linked to the lab object store.
findings.blocking_rationale: A wrong path can certify cleanup while the failed fixture remains, or target another tree for removal. Changing an attribute through a hard link also changes it through the shared file’s other names.
findings.expected: A cleanup retry identifies this run’s disposable root before mutation and preserves the retained producer, other worktrees and shared Git files.
findings.requested_correction: Bind any retry to the exact fixture created by this run and verify that its path and the producer path are disjoint in both directions. Limit cleanup to owned entries without changing shared-file attributes. Preserve the exported helper as the record of the failed run.
findings.requested_evidence: Identify the actual fixture and producer paths. Show that a different prefixed directory and a parent containing the producer are rejected before mutation. A read-only path check suffices for those controls.
findings.title: Confine the cleanup retry to this run’s disposable files
findings.trigger: The completion helper receives a different focused-r9- path, or encounters a read-only Git file shared by the disposable clone and the lab repository.

findings.actual: The driver recorded 16 passing cases. The completion script appends one combined case whose cleanup condition failed, yielding 16/17. The published 17/18 summary splits that case afterward. I reproduced the index’s raw digest 69fb0e67… from the already-split JSON by restoring its local prefix and line formatting. Its fixture_area_note also says removal succeeded beside fixture_area_removed=false.
findings.blocking_rationale: The index identifies postprocessed bytes as the raw run output and the note contradicts the observed cleanup result. Accurate evidence attribution is required by OWNER AMENDMENTS 3 and 4.
findings.expected: The index distinguishes the executed completion result from any derived summary and accurately records the failed cleanup.
findings.requested_correction: Identify the original completion capture and its digest if retained. Label the 17/18 split and its digest as derived. Annotate the erroneous cleanup note while preserving the failed run. State explicitly if the original capture is unavailable.
findings.requested_evidence: Provide traceable original and derived identities, their actual case counts and exit status, and verified committed-blob digests. Existing records suffice for this correction.
findings.title: Distinguish the failed completion run from its derived summary
findings.trigger: A reviewer uses the evidence index to reproduce the completion driver’s reported outcome.

prior_finding_assessments.rationale: The helper resolves the remapped icon to assets/game/icons/black-powder.png and the case-variant README to README.md at the producing commit. The real ordinary reader refused both edited archives. The clean-package and unshipped-note controls passed.

The writer and both staging readers supply the receipt’s expected digest. Hashing and member inspection use the same held ZIP handle. The matching archive passed and replacements in both directions failed the digest check.

The producer, canonical layout, sidecars and matching four-profile audit are verified. The required post-cleanup observation remains outstanding because fixture removal failed before the recorded admission.

OWNER AMENDMENT 4 expressly keeps this fixture assertion optional. The recorded run identified the locked ZIP, restored sentinel and successful staging control. More precise instrumentation of the destination-verification step can remain deferred.
